about_the_game:
You are her eyes. But will that be enough to save her?

Sophie is trapped, blind, alone, and lost in a crumbling mansion. Her only hope? You, her beloved teddy bear. In Out of Sight VR, you don’t just guide her - you see through Teddy’s eyes, navigating a world of creeping shadows and haunting secrets.

See through Teddy’s eyes.

Flip the perspective and take control in a genre-defying second-person VR experience.

This groundbreaking second-person VR horror flips the script on traditional perspective. As Teddy, you’re not just a participant, you’re her lifeline. Strategically position yourself to scout dangers, uncover hidden paths, and lead Sophie away from the sinister figures hunting her every move.

One wrong step can cost everything.

Stay silent. Stay hidden. The mansion listens, and so do they.

Tension hangs on every breath, and each movement must be planned with care. One wrong step, one creak of the floorboards, and Sophie could be caught.

Second-perspective puzzles demand quick thinking.

Scout. Solve. Survive. Guide Sophie safely through complex environmental challenges.

Face perspective-shifting chase sequences, solve second-perspective puzzles, and uncover the tragic history buried within the mansion’s walls. As fear builds and reality fractures, the line between protector and prisoner begins to blur.

Unravel a story of fear, loss, and resilience.

Discover the haunting past hidden inside the walls and within Sophie herself.

Dripping with atmosphere and driven by emotional stakes, Out of Sight VR is more than a horror game; it’s a test of empathy, instinct, and resolve. Every choice you make as Teddy could mean survival...or silence.

Also available in standard PC mode for players without a VR headset. Experience the story from a new perspective, however you choose to play.

Will you bring her to safety…or become another shadow lost to the dark?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: 4 hardware CPU Threads Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: Out of Sight VR pulls you into a chilling nightmare where you see through the eyes of a child’s only comfort: her teddy bear. Guide Sophie through a sinister mansion and evade the lurking horrors that stalk her every move. The shadows are watching. And Sophie is counting on you.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
